name: 01-immediate-after-hangup
title: 복습
visibleText:
복습
남겨둔 복습 · 1개
Alex와 나눈 대화문

통화 음성을 종료했어요. 마지막 발화의 전사와 서버 저장을 확인하고 있어요.

자동 전사된 기록이에요. 중간에 멈춘 답변은 실제로 들은 내용과 다를 수 있어요.

대화문 보기 · 12개 발화
나: Yesterday I go to a cafe with my friend. It was very nice. We stayed there for almost two hours.
Alex: That sounds like a relaxed afternoon. What did you like about the cafe?
나: I liked the big windows and the quiet music. We could talk without shouting, and the coffee was really good.
Alex: A quiet place makes catching up easier. Did you try anything with your coffee?
나: Yes, we shared a piece of cheesecake. I usually prefer something less sweet, but this one was quite light.
Alex: That sounds like a good match for the coffee. Would you go back to the same place?
나: I think I would. My friend wants to go again next month, but I also want to try a new place near the station.
Alex: You have two good options. What have you heard about the place near the station?
나: It opens early, so we could have breakfast before the park gets crowded. I saw a few photos and the sandwiches looked delicious.
Alex: Breakfast followed by a walk sounds like a good plan. How would you invite your friend?
나: Maybe I could say, would you like to have breakfast and take a walk with me next Saturday?

이 기기 보관 확인 · 서버 전송 대기

Alex: That invitation is clear and friendly. You can keep it that simple.
